name: O Barco de Valdeorras (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red below and white above with a light blue triangle at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of O Barco de Valdeorras; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle at the lower fly between the red and the white
